mapper.select: SELECT f.festival_number, f.status, f.festival_name, f.start_date, f.end_date, f.progress_status, f.address, f.contents, f.image_url FROM festivals f WHERE f.festival_number = #{festivalNumber};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO festivals ( festival_number, festival_name, start_date, end_date, progress_status, address, contents, image_URL, status) VALUES ( NEXTVAL(festivals_seq), #{festivalName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{progressStatus}, #{address}, #{contents}, #{imageUrl}, 1)
INSERT INTO add_tags ( add_tag_number, is_main, festival_number, tag_number ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL(add_tags_seq), #{isMain}, #{festivalNumber}, #{tagNumber});
mapper.update:
UPDATE tags SET
festival_count = festival_count + 1 festival_count = festival_count - 1
WHERE tag_number IN ( SELECT tag_number FROM add_tags WHERE festival_number = #{festivalNumber} )

UPDATE festivals SET festival_name = #{festivalName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, address = #{address}, contents = #{contents}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE festival_number = #{festivalNumber};
